response.sql:
SELECT t.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
FROM telescopes AS t
JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM telescopes AS t2
  WHERE t2.observstation = t.observstation
    AND t2.equipstatus = 'Maintenance'
)
GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage
ORDER BY telescope_count DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Count all matched telescopes in each station and moon-phase group, including those whose bandwidth usage is missing; AVG ignores missing bandwidth values as requested.
